description.value: Munson Mountain Park is a municipal nature reserve and prominent hilltop landmark in Penticton, BC, managed by the City of Penticton. The site offers a popular hiking destination within the city, with sweeping views over Okanagan Lake and Skaha Lake that draw both residents and visiting cyclists. It is a well-known attraction on the cycling tourism circuit through the South Okanagan.
